rooms.description: Small bedroom with a mirrored reach-in closet. 2 photos, iPhone 1x camera.

truth.notes: User-measured, approximate: 12.47 × 9.02 ft. The 12.47 ft length INCLUDES the reach-in closet (mirrored sliding doors); the 9.02 ft width does not. The second white hinged door leads to ANOTHER room (bathroom), not a closet: it is not part of this floor, so an estimate that adds a second closet for it is overcounting. Main-room-only dimensions and closet size are unknown, so only total area is scored.

conditions.invalidReason: The 12.47 ft length includes the closet, but a known measurement must be the main room only (wall to wall, excluding closets). Re-measure without the closet to enable this condition.
